<script></script><section class="nu-hero" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(11,34,43,.72),rgba(11,34,43,.25),rgba(11,34,43,.04)),url(https://numerounopr.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep-apts-tall-2@2x.webp)"><div class="nu-hero-content"><p class="nu-kicker">Room Type</p><h1>Beach Apartments</h1><p>Need more space during your stay? Reserve one of our apartments! Numero Uno Beach Apartments are located only steps away from our beachfront hotel property. Each apartment features 1 or 2 bedrooms, a futon, bathroom, and a kitchenette. The units are managed by our professional, 24-hour hospitality staff at the Beach House, and are steps from the beach. Comfortable for families and small groups.</p><div class="nu-btns"><a class="nu-btn" href="https://hotel2625.openhotel.com/results.cfm" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book room</a><a class="nu-btn alt" href="/hotel/apartments/">All rooms</a></div></div></section><section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-two"><div><p class="nu-eyebrow">Room Capacity</p><h2>4 Adults</h2><p>Need more space during your stay? Reserve one of our apartments! Numero Uno Beach Apartments are located only steps away from our beachfront hotel property. Each apartment features 1 or 2 bedrooms, a futon, bathroom, and a kitchenette. The units are managed by our professional, 24-hour hospitality staff at the Beach House, and are steps from the beach. Comfortable for families and small groups.</p><p class="nu-eyebrow" style="margin-top:26px!important">Room Amenities</p><div class="nu-pills"><span>4 Adults</span><span>Queen Size Bed</span><span>Air Conditioning</span><span>Private Bath &#038; Shower</span><span>Free Toiletries</span><span>Flat Screen Smart TV</span><span>DirecTV</span><span>Complimentary Wi-fi</span><span>Mini Refrigerator</span><span>In-room Safe</span><span>Daily Housekeeping Service</span></div></div><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep-apts-tall-2@2x.webp" alt="Beach Apartments"></div></section><section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-gallery"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep-apts-9@2x.webp" alt="Beach Apartments"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep-apts-8@2x.webp" alt="Beach Apartments"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep-apts-5@2x.webp" alt="Beach Apartments"><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/img-beachhouse-sleep-apts-2@2x.webp" alt="Beach Apartments"></div></section><section class="nu-section"><div class="nu-footercta"><h2>Book room</h2><p>Beach Apartments</p><div class="nu-btns" style="justify-content:center"><a class="nu-btn" href="https://hotel2625.openhotel.com/results.cfm" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book room</a><a class="nu-btn alt" href="/hotel/apartments/">All rooms</a></div></div></section></div>
